models_evaluated: System A: NLP-based CDSS evaluating data extracted outside the EHR
System B: commercial EHR functionality using LOINC-defined result fields

links.outcome: Completion of recommended follow-up at 120 days, CDSS alone vs usual care
links.effect: In a cluster RCT, CDSS alone versus usual care did not improve follow-up outcomes in either system.
links.quote: CDSS alone versus usual care did not improve outcomes in either system.

links.outcome: Follow-up completion when CDSS output paired with defined patient outreach action
links.effect: CDSS with outreach with or without navigation vs usual care: System A 38.2% or 37.2% vs 23.5% (p<0.001); System B 25.4% or 23% vs 19.7% (p=0.044). CDSS alone gave no improvement.
links.quote: CDSS with patient outreach with or without navigation versus usual care significantly increased follow-up rates in System A (38.2 % or 37.2 % vs 23.5 %, p < 0.001) and System B (25.4 % or 23 % vs. 19.7 %, p = 0.044).

models_evaluated: System A: natural language processing of extracted data outside the EHR
System B: commercial EHR functionality using LOINC-defined result fields

links.outcome: Completion of recommended follow-up within 120 days
links.effect: CDSS alone: no improvement. Outreach with/without navigation: System A, 38.2 % or 37.2 % vs 23.5 %, p < 0.001; System B, 25.4 % or 23 % vs. 19.7 %, p = 0.044.
links.quote: Both models with patient outreach with or without navigation - but not CDSS alone - increased recommended follow-up.

links.outcome: CDSS true-positive identification assessed by manual chart review
links.effect: CDSS true positives were 61.3 % in System A and 70.4 % in System B.
links.quote: CDSS true positives were 61.3 % in System A and 70.4 % in System B.

unlisted_practices: Adding portal/mailed letters and a single phone call, with or without additional telephone navigation addressing care barriers, for patients identified by CDSS as overdue for follow-up.

links.effect: CDSS with patient outreach increased follow-up to 38.2% vs 23.5% in System A, and 25.4% vs 19.7% in System B, whereas CDSS alone did not.
links.quote: CDSS with patient outreach with or without navigation versus usual care significantly increased follow-up rates in System A (38.2 % or 37.2 % vs 23.5 %, p < 0.001) and System B (25.4 % or 23 % vs. 19.7 %, p = 0.044).
